name: OmeroExtractor
purpose: Extracts metadata from an OMERO.Server (Open Microscopy Environment) and exposes it as semantically enriched JSON-LD/RDF. Connects to OMERO.Web API to pull structured image/dataset/ROI metadata, fetches raw key-value pairs from microscope acquisition software, and converts merged JSON to RDF using a custom OME ontology generated from the official OME XSD schema.
pipeline_position: Stage 1 extractor for OMERO microscopy data

ontologies_used.name: OME (custom)
ontologies_used.role: Core microscopy types (Image, Dataset, Channel, ROI) — generated from ome.xsd via xsd2owl

ontologies_used.name: Open Annotation
ontologies_used.role: Wraps key/value acquisition metadata as oa:Annotation entries

ontologies_used.name: QUDT
ontologies_used.role: Numeric acquisition values typed as qudt:QuantityValue

files.description: Real OMERO image 83 metadata (TEM microscopy, anonymized)

api_endpoints.summary: Extract metadata for a single OMERO image → RDF

anonymize.description: Strip PII (owner name, email) from output

api_endpoints.summary: Extract metadata for a dataset (collection of images) → RDF
Extract ROI (Region of Interest) annotations for an image → RDF

configuration.description: OMERO public user (service account — end users need no OMERO credentials)
OMERO admin user for fallback auth

real_world_example.description: Dark-field TEM precipitate analysis on steel samples at BAM. Full pipeline: OmeroExtractor → MapToMethod → RDFConverter → Fuseki

publication.title: FAIR microscopy data via the Mat-O-Lab pipeline

capabilities: Extracts full OMERO image + dataset + ROI metadata in one call
Merges structured OMERO.Web API data with raw acquisition metadata from microscope software
OME ontology alignment via ome.ttl (generated from official OME XSD schema)
QUDT unit annotation on numeric acquisition parameters
Web form UI at / for ad-hoc image ID lookup
limitations: Requires an accessible OMERO.Web instance configured via env vars
v0.0.4 — early stage; API surface may change
No bulk/batch extraction — one image/dataset per API call
Domain-specific mapping from OME ontology to target ontologies (e.g. PMDco) requires downstream YARRRML mapping
